study.question: Can explicitly preserving historical feedback groups until task-conditioned residual readout improve four-task discrimination beyond per-task score rows? Observed full-validation macro AUCs: baseline-din 0.8099233881; task_action 0.8114567736; shared_action 0.8111539425; task_item 0.8071249583; shared_item 0.8068573953. Action access contrast is +0.0043318153 with task rows; task-row contrast is only +0.0003028311 with actions and +0.0002675630 without actions; factorial interaction is +0.0000352681. The incumbent compresses every feedback into one vector per prediction task; no explicit feedback-separated readout remains. Against DIN the incumbent task AUC deltas in click/cart/fav/buy order are +0.0005307717/+0.0028196098/+0.0027792529/+0.0000039076 and Logloss deltas are -0.0002234734/+0.0000494000/+0.0000588236/+0.0001800439. Macro Logloss worsens from 0.0566229514 to 0.0566391499. These observations motivate a representation test; they do not establish negative transfer.
study.hypothesis: A signed weighted sum over all feedback may entangle rare feedback-specific item evidence with common exposures even when its scalar scorer sees actions. Retaining overlapping feedback-group summaries and allowing each prediction task to weight them using target/context and support may expose complementary evidence before the final tower. Keep the all-event path to avoid forcing rare tasks to rely on empty groups. Mechanism support requires semantic alignment to beat a count/overlap-preserving misalignment control, rather than just beating the historical parent.

nearest_work.difference: Inspected pinned benchmark implementation at commit 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, SHA256 e3750a73af1ceb6b2be4bf9355b70a9ad356985a3c465ef27238ef7e0f28fb4c, especially lines 53, 82-100 and 123-159. That implementation initializes behavior hubs with task masks and repeatedly exchanges categorical/sequence/task information. Here reuse only the feedback-group representation idea: score-weighted group residuals beside the incumbent, one count/context-conditioned router, no iterative hub broadcast or new sequence encoder. This is an adaptation and controlled local contrast; no originality or original-method reproduction claim.

study.proposed_difference: Compute five weighted summaries per prediction task using its retained relevance scores: all valid exposures and four authorized historical-feedback masks. Divide each sum by sqrt(max(group_count,1)); keep group overlap. A width-32 ReLU router produces 4x5 logits from concatenated user/context/target embeddings and normalized log1p counts. Mask unavailable feedback groups and use the all-event zero summary as a finite sentinel for empty histories. Softmax is evaluated in FP32. Add the routed summary to the unchanged all-event summary through four learned gains initialized to 0.1; retain tower input width and default BCE. Alignment A and direct context routing C form a 2x2 factorial with four standalone files. A0 reverses mask assignments only over valid positions, preserving counts and every intersection. C0 zeros direct user/context/target router inputs but retains count inputs. No new data, timestamps, action-vocabulary assumptions, future visibility, labels, recipe changes or installs. Local coding environment has no torch: only source/syntax and pure-Python control-invariant checks can run; tensor forward/backward/BF16 checks remain host prerequisites. Completed local checks: all four modules parse/compile, study matches the resolved strict schema, variant configs and constructor defaults agree, source differences are restricted to the two declared factors, all five ancestor hashes and baseline_reference hash match accepted receipts, and 4080 scalar reversal cases preserve counts/intersections, padding exclusion and involution. These scalar checks do not execute tensor code. Raw parquet inputs are not present among public coding-workspace files; dataset digest and data gating remain host-owned prerequisites under the accepted frozen protocol.
predictions: Primary preregistered contrasts: AUC(feedback_context)-AUC(reversed_context)>0 and AUC(feedback_support)-AUC(reversed_support)>0 would support aligned feedback separation at matched active capacity; repeat before a mechanism claim.

Context increment: AUC(feedback_context)-AUC(feedback_support)>0; interaction [(feedback_context-feedback_support)-(reversed_context-reversed_support)]>0 would suggest that explicit context especially helps aligned evidence. A zero interaction permits independent grouping/context effects.

Candidate should exceed parent 0.8114567735949517 by frozen macro-AUC selection. Record all four AUC/Logloss deltas against both parent and baseline; purchase/auxiliary calibration improvement is a secondary prediction, not an undeclared veto.

Reuse supplied history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with sample/positive/negative counts. Existing parent macro-AUC gains over DIN are -0.0109517770/+0.0004472296/+0.0018878227/+0.0022684591 respectively. Empty history has only 6444 impressions and 13 purchase positives; regard that estimate as unstable. Existing bins are confirmatory diagnostics, not evidence that history length causes gains.

If host diagnostics are exposed, preregister feedback support bins 0,1,2-4,>=5 events per task and report group overlap, counts and uncertainty. Missing diagnostics are unavailable evidence, not zero effects. Do not modify scorer or data to obtain them.

Host prerequisites: finite outputs and backward on empty/length-one/mixed/full histories in train/eval and BF16; four label-shaped outputs; zero summaries for empty history; invariance to target-action and padded-ID changes at fixed masks; invariance to out-of-mask group flags; identical parameter counts across cells; parameter/control tensor shapes and missing-group routing verified before full jobs.
falsifiers: Aligned variants fail to beat their reversed counterparts under paired authorized repetitions: no controlled support for explicit semantic grouping, even if every cell improves the parent.
Context router fails to beat support-only routing: do not attribute a gain to the direct context path. If only support-only wins, retain the simpler variant under the unchanged selection rule.

Only reversed cells improve, residual gains collapse toward zero, or benefits occur equally on empty/group-free histories: investigate generic scaling, optimization and count effects before claiming complementary-feedback exchange.
Any improvement that disappears with paired repetitions or user-cluster uncertainty remains preliminary; inability to execute a variant is an implementation/cost failure, not a mechanism refutation.
Nonfinite/masking-contract failures or the unchanged 1208.541376-second cap prevent an admissible comparison; retain failure receipts and costs.
alternative_explanations: Extra router parameters, support-count features, residual normalization/scaling or changed random initialization could explain gains over the parent. The new four-cell factorial is initialized identically across cells, but parent initialization is not guaranteed identical because added module construction/reset consumes RNG.
Reversal is a deterministic corruption control, not a random independent mechanism replicate; palindromic assignments and length-one histories are unchanged.
All variants retain historical action embeddings and group counts, so the control tests explicit event/group alignment, not removal of all feedback information.
The support-only router has the same allocated shape but lower effective capacity; its summaries remain target-conditioned through the retained scorer.
Rare-group support, learned residual gain, signed relevance weights and sqrt(count) scaling can affect optimization; their main effects are shared across the factorial.
Single frozen seed, single pass, repeated user exposures and validation reuse prevent claims of statistical significance or generalization to production.
Shared embeddings and scorer gradients remain; this experiment does not directly measure or eliminate gradient conflict. An AUC gain alone is not proof of reduced negative transfer.

Review of all five supplied trajectories: every execution succeeded, but both action-ablated branches are below DIN and are retained as negative outcomes. No failed receipts or additional agent-memory matches were supplied. Prior knowledge-usage declarations identify executed variants, not confirmed mechanisms.

Offline action visibility can include delayed feedback not mature at real serving time; auxiliary labels are future user/category/brand outcomes, not advertisement-specific conversions. Whole-window filtering and static snapshots are inherited. Claims are limited to this offline validation protocol.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Four full-protocol cells are charged, including controls/preflight/failures. Plan roughly 500-750 seconds each (unmeasured engineering estimate), provision up to 4*1208.541376=4834.165504 seconds without raising caps. Reserve another 6000 seconds for a discriminating residual/count replacement and paired repeats if host authorization and remaining budget permit. No subset screens or local training. Extra dense parameters exactly 32*C+856 for C=concatenated user/context/target width; embeddings/towers unchanged. Pooling adds O(B*T*G*L*V), G=5,T=4, plus O(B*L*log L) index sorting and O(B*T*G*V) summaries; no L-squared attention. Measure actual train/validation time, peak memory, parameters and batch latency before efficiency claims. Matched passes are the primary mechanism comparison; measured equal-compute claims require a later matched budget, not time extrapolation.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Local action ablations motivate preserving feedback evidence; inspected pinned benchmark forward establishes that authorized task masks can seed behavior groups. The prior task-row contrast was small and does not confirm the industry mechanism.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Task-scored overlapping feedback-group summaries with an all-event residual fallback and one context/support router; 2x2 count-preserving alignment and direct-context controls.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: One-stage additive readout on the empirical incumbent, without INFNet categorical/task hubs, iterative aggregation, broadcast or token encoder; original-paper equivalence and originality unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No aligned-over-reversed macro-AUC contrast after paired repetition, or a gain explained equally by generic residual/count controls.

knowledge_assessments.falsifier: A later matched field-interaction replacement may outperform grouping and show the bottleneck lies downstream of history compression.
